mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales of Goods signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent GDP growth slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or UNRATE increase does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY is above 2%, the combination signals a mismatch between monetary policy and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the interaction of low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent policy adjustments.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances despite positive signal, or HOUST increase does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE is above 7% and PAYEMS growth is negative, the combination signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the interaction of high UNRATE and negative PAYEMS growth does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in GDP (GDPC1) signals weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or GDPC1 decline does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.
